requiredFindings.title: Express has two conflicting current SM-2 records per reset
requiredFindings.evidence: PLAN-r3 D-4 selects the synthesized program for Express SM-2. The derivation first includes Express from the cohort, then appends the synthesized result with the same language/row/component/reset key. Warm medians are129941504 bytes (cohort) and269156352 bytes (synthesized); cold medians are129810432 bytes (cohort) and269418496 bytes (synthesized). All four are labelled current SM-2 records. The report generator silently keeps the last record per reset, so its table shows only the synthesized value.
requiredFindings.impact: Although each RSS statistic matches its own source, the machine record is ambiguous about the authoritative Express F/T component and includes two records from the wrong D-4 source. Consumers selecting the first match can report roughly half the selected process peak.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Exclude Express from the cohort loop for current SM-2 entries and retain the synthesized source for both resets. If preserving cohort information, put it in a separately labelled informational collection that is explicitly not D-4 SM-2. Update the current-entry count and report, add a read-only uniqueness check by language/row/component/reset/entry identity, and regenerate the subject. No measurement rerun is needed.
